name: MKX Disposable Tropix | Strawberry Lemonade
description:
Rechargeable Disposable Battery, 1g Premium Distillate: Strawberry Lemonade

Introducing MKX's new TropiX Disposables. Take a vacation whenever, and now wherever. While utilizing a sleek, lightweight, and highly portable design. MKX pairs premium distillate with High-quality terpenes, to transport anyone and everyone to paradise. Full gram disposable cartridges with a wide assortment of tasty tropical flavors. It's a vacation in your pocket with MKX's TropiX Disposables.
